verdict.rationale: Scoped credentials are a fair question for an always-on agent product, so the axis applies. The evidence shows no way to issue scoped or least-privilege API credentials for the dot. The closest item is inherited ChatGPT app permissions (e.g., read email without send) and a login form, which are adjacent host-platform controls rather than credential issuance. The runtime probe also found no dots-specific public API surface.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
